rustc 1.94.0 (4a4ef493e 2026-03-02)
binary: rustc

commit-date: 2026-03-02

release: 1.94.0
LLVM version: 21.1.8
round-1-after.fixture_identity_policy: Schema manifests and fixture versions must match across engines and rounds. Legacy binaries without fixed IDs remain diagnostic only.
round-1-after.method: Sequential fresh process/database per mode/size/round, mode order rotated across rounds and sizes. One warmup per query, identical fixed iteration counts and checked results. Local retained-snapshot authorized reads; SQLite/PostgreSQL have no equivalent row authorization. OS caches are not dropped. PostgreSQL uses per-row prepared protocol calls over a local Unix socket (including IPC and decoding), not a bulk loader. Each case has a fresh PG18 cluster; setup is outside load timing and recorded separately. Client resources include loading, and exclude the PostgreSQL server. Server resources are separately labeled; 250 ms process sampling adds monitoring overhead to PostgreSQL cases only. Native modes use public point/lookup/page APIs; aggregate operations are explicit client folds, not engine aggregate plans. Resident public scans eagerly copy rows; paged scans use 256-row pages. Native range folds scan and filter; SQL can use indexed ranges. Untimed diagnostic reruns/storage accounting are included in whole-process resources but excluded from per-query measurements.
